name: verify_pak_contents
purpose: Enumerate what is actually inside a .utoc/.ucas (or retoc trio) before/after deploying a mod, instead of shipping a pak blind.
cooked: works — reads the container file directly, not the mount
prevents: shipping a pak blind — content only inferable from runtime behaviour today
hazards: Refuse >100 MB utoc with an error rather than stalling the frame
Non-Indexed containers yield chunk IDs only — must return indexed:false, not fake filenames

name: mount_pak
purpose: Mount a mod's retoc trio (or any pak/IoStore container) into the running editor so its packages become loadable without restart.
cooked: works — cooked content is the whole point; loads via cooked-editor path
hazards: Must NOT be inside the blanket transaction — Ctrl-Z cannot unmount; undo entry would be a lie
Premade asset registry blindness — freshly mounted packages invisible to find_assets
Already-loaded package shadowing — override only seen by future loads; warn with count
Double-mount tolerated by engine — pre-check GetMountedPakFilenames and error

name: unmount_pak
purpose: Undo mount_pak in the same session (iterate: repack then remount).
cooked: works — container-only concept, same as mount
hazards: Refuse-when-loaded guard is mandatory and non-optional — dangling bulk-data refs crash
Unmounting with live objects breaks lazy loads (streamed mips, bulk data) unless force:true

name: refresh_asset_registry
purpose: Make the asset registry learn about new loose files dropped into /Game/MODS out-of-editor, without restarting.
cooked: degraded — refuses to help for container-only content; works for loose files
hazards: Refuse bare /Game with path-too-broad error to bound the synchronous scan stall
IoStore-only packages are not scannable — must say so when scan yields 0 but pak layer matches
No FScopedTransaction — registry is not undoable; avoid an empty undo entry

name: list_native_classes
purpose: Enumerate the native class surface of a /Script module — today describe_class needs a name the agent cannot discover.
cooked: works — native classes are never cooked-stripped, full fidelity

name: mod_package_request
purpose: Actually execute the retoc pack/deploy lane that trigger_cook only plans, from the editor session, with a poll.
cooked: n/a — operates on cooked artefacts by design; editor assets untouched
hazards: Never call FPlatformProcess::WaitForProc in the handler — drain ReadPipe only at poll time
Single-flight job table — second request while running must error
Do not trust exit codes alone — return stdout tail (UnrealPak exit-255 precedent)
Deploy can fail on .ucas file locks held by a running game — surface, do not retry

name: read_modloader_log
purpose: Structured events instead of raw lines from UE4SS.log — agents currently regex a text blob.
engineApi: FFileHelper::LoadFileToStringArray (existing, MifBridgePipeline.cpp:56) — the log FORMAT is the verified surface
cooked: n/a — file read of the live game's log
hazards: Current handler silently ignores unknown params — fix strictness in the same change
64 MB guard is flag-only today — LoadFileToStringArray still reads the entire file; make it real
UE4SS.log is rewritten per game session — since/cached counts invalid across sessions; return mtime/size
Unparseable lines must emit as channel:raw, never drop

name: list_ue4ss_mods
purpose: One call answering what mods are installed/enabled/deployed and whether a deploy actually landed, across four on-disk locations.
hazards: The .bak/.pre*/.retired suffix zoo in Mods/LogicMods must be classified, not filtered out
mods.txt absent is not an error — BPModLoader still loads by directory scan; warn only
